[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/hb-open-file.hh", "function": "OpenTypeFontFile::sanitize", "line": 470, "var": "u.tag", "code": "switch (u.tag) { case DFontTag: return_trace (u.rfHeader.sanitize (c)); }", "note": "The input file begins with the DFont tag 0x00000100, so the parser dispatches to ResourceForkHeader::sanitize for the attacker-controlled dfont resource fork."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/hb-open-file.hh", "function": "ResourceForkHeader::sanitize", "line": 431, "var": "data", "code": "map.sanitize (c, this, &(this+data))", "note": "The ResourceForkHeader's data offset field is 0x100 (256), pointing exactly at the end of the 256-byte input buffer. The vulnerable code lacks a data.sanitize(c,this,dataLen) bounds check, so &(this+data) is computed as an out-of-bounds pointer."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/hb-open-file.hh", "function": "ResourceForkHeader::sanitize", "line": 431, "var": "&(this+data)", "code": "map.sanitize (c, this, &(this+data))", "note": "&(this+data) dereferences the data offset via OffsetTo::operator(), producing a data_base pointer that lies beyond the end of the heap buffer. This out-of-bounds data_base is passed into ResourceMap::sanitize as the resource-data base."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/hb-open-type.hh", "function": "OffsetTo::sanitize", "line": 265, "var": "this->is_null()", "code": "sanitize_shallow (c, base) && (this->is_null () || ...)", "note": "During map.sanitize, sanitize_shallow calls check_struct on the map offset field. The map offset value 0x20202020 is read; because the data region was never validated, the subsequent offset dereference reads past the buffer."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/hb-machinery.hh", "function": "BEInt<Type,2>::operator Type", "line": 655, "var": "v[0]", "code": "return (v[0] << 8) + (v[1]);", "note": "The 2-byte offset value is read via BEInt::operator unsigned short. The read lands 24 bytes past the 256-byte heap allocation, producing the ASAN heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json, steps:', len(d))"
